GHA.note: The notice sets duties on banks (biometric verification, liveness checks, multifactor authentication) and names no authentication service of the ID system.
No civil register link is mentioned.
No enrolment count or share is stated.
No number at birth is mentioned.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
The notice concerns financial institutions, not a public register keyed on the number.
The notice requires banks to verify customers biometrically; it does not state that the ID system checks biometrics at enrolment or is certified.
